verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack contains no API reference, API explorer or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file describes the company in general and is not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
